notes: Modified cash basis city. Governmental figures from Total Governmental Funds column of the receipts/disbursements statement (p4); beginning/ending cash = beginning/ending fund balance (all cash). Roll: 10,590,063 + 8,740,248 - 7,678,764 + 327,653 debt proceeds (transfers in/out 330,750 each net to zero) = 11,979,200. Re-check (attempt 2): balance-sheet governmental lines now from the governmental funds Balance Sheet - Modified Cash Basis (p3, Total Governmental Funds column; fund balance by classification: Restricted 3,352,759, Committed 4,793,373, Assigned 2,102,318, Unassigned 1,730,750), whose total 11,979,200 equals the government-wide governmental column (p1); business-type lines and the printed totals stay from the Statement of Net Position (p1). Business-type lines come from the accrual-style Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Net Position (p6, Total column), so business_type.beginning/ending (16,507,083 / 17,820,506) differ from the modified-cash government-wide business-type net position (6,607,155 / 7,542,904, p1-2); reconciliation on p5. Loss on sale of capital assets (77) recorded as business_type.other_financing; 16,507,083 + 2,952,702 - 1,639,202 - 77 = 17,820,506. Business-type receipts/disbursements are sums (operating + nonoperating) as noted in computed. Taxes 4,474,002 kept unlabeled: Statement of Activities p2 general receipts (property 1,794,730, MV 162,467, sales/use 1,348,123, in lieu 9,376, occupation 462,888) plus TIF 666,246 and special assessments 30,533 come to 4,474,363, not exact. Business-type 'Proceeds from loans' 1,120,000 (cash flows p7) are not in the net position statement and not recorded. Statement of cash flows p7 is accrual-proprietary on the fund statement; proprietary left null (basis is modified cash). Budgetary comparison schedule (p8) only shows fund-level totals (General, Debt Service, Street, Other, Sales Tax, Lottery, Water, Sewer, Transfers; total receipts 13,503,867, disbursements 11,158,547 on budgetary basis incl. loan proceeds) with no revenue/function lines. Detail (user 2026-10-27): per-fund lines from the fund statements' columns (p4, p6) replace the combined schedule. Read pages 1-8 of 8

decision_needed.question: Business-type lines come from the accrual Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Net Position (p6), which includes non-cash depreciation 654,238 and leaves out capital purchases 1,358,182, principal paid 630,000 and loan proceeds 1,120,000 (cash flows p7). The modified-cash Statement of Activities (p2) shows business-type disbursements 3,149,033 (Water 1,748,094 + Sewer 1,400,939) with no line breakdown. Should the business-type figures use the modified-cash totals instead of the accrual fund statement?
decision_needed.recorded_as: business-type disbursements 1,639,202 from p6 (operating expenses incl. depreciation + interest expense); business_type measure net position 16,507,083 to 17,820,506

decision_needed.question: The Budgetary Comparison Schedule (p8) prints only fund-level actuals (receipts by fund totalling 13,503,867 and disbursements by fund totalling 11,158,547, both incl. transfers 330,750 and the Water/Sewer funds on a cash basis), with no revenue or function lines and only an all-funds budget. Should these fund totals be recorded in detail, given they have no revenue-source breakdown to categorise?
decision_needed.recorded_as: not in detail (detail empty); governmental fund totals equal the p4 fund columns
